test_read_missing_file: test that read_csv, read_ipc, read_json, read_parquet, read_avro, scan_csv, scan_ipc, scan_parquet raise FileNotFoundError for missing files
test_write_missing_directory: test that write_csv, write_ipc, write_ipc_stream, write_json, write_ndjson, write_parquet, write_avro raise FileNotFoundError for non-existing paths
test_read_missing_file_path_truncated: test that polars truncates long missing file paths in error messages with ellipsis
test_read_missing_file_path_expanded_whe: test that setting POLARS_VERBOSE=1 expands the full file path in FileNotFoundError messages
test_copy: test that copy.copy and copy.deepcopy work correctly on polars DataFrames and Series
